Hi Rebecca —

Thanks for the heads up and the deadline. Short answers up front:
- Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2025-11-01 through 2026-10-31.
- We can provide an interim attestation letter (attestation that controls remained in place since the last audit) that can be dated to cover up to your renewal date (12/15/2026).
- Typical evidence we provide for procurement: the Type II report PDF, an interim attestation letter, our system architecture summary for data flows, and a limited set of control artifacts (access control matrix excerpt, log retention policy, incident response runbook).

Im looping in Soojin (Security) and Jordan (Legal) to confirm timelines and whether there are any redlines on the attestation wording. We can send the Type II report immediately and draft the interim attestation template for your review.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: share Type II PDF (we can attach now)
- Mon 11/29: draft interim attestation sent to you for acceptance
- Tue 12/01: legal sign-off / DocuSign link if required

If procurement requires a signed letter on company letterhead rather than a template, we can arrange that as well. Let me know if Finex needs the attestation to reference a specific audit standard language.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
